[decimals]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The number of decimal places. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The formatted percentage. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} A proportion of `0.256` is 25.6%: ::: {#8dc50c1f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from tinytab import fmt_percent fmt_percent(0.256) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` '25.6%' ``` ::: ::: Use `decimals=` to change the precision: ::: {#63f2b13a .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} fmt_percent(0.256, decimals=0) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` '26%' ``` ::: :::
